explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that the library's own integral Bockstein map in continuous group cohomology, `TauCeti.integralBockstein`, is zero when the modulus is 1. Mathlib has no continuous-cohomology Bockstein map. The proof does not apply any Mathlib result that carries this content. It uses only the library's own lemma `mem_range_integralBockstein_iff`, plus `ConcreteCategory.hom_ext` and `simp`. All of the mathematical content therefore lies in the library's own definitions.
